validation_selection: highest accuracy, then lowest selection NLL, then lowest learning rate
evaluation: all 3080 official test examples and all 1000 calibration examples, after tuning is frozen
scope: Longer fixed-exposure main comparison. 4000 initial plus 4000 continuation examples is approximately one training epoch total; this is not a convergence guarantee.
precision: 0.8B and 4B BF16 LoRA; 9B NF4 QLoRA. Further precision replication remains required.
continuation_data: Replay the seed-matched data RNG and skip the initial exposure; continued SFT, exact, and sampled see the same subsequent examples and candidate order.
